main_text.p: te longâ, acuitur penultima. ut: ἡρωΐνη, ἀνθρώπως.
[Excipe Attica, quæ ab hac regulâ libera sunt. ut: Μενέλεως, πόλεως.]
iv. Ultimâ exsistente brevi in polysyllabis, acuitur antepenultima. ut: αὐτοῦ ἡρωων, μαρτύρεσον.
[Excipe: 1. Nomina verbalia in ῶν, iii. derivata à Præterito medio, & cum aliis Nominibus composita: quæ si activè capiantur, accentum habent in penultimâ. ut: Ἡσμάχων, ἀνδροφόνων.]
2. Verbalia in ῶν & εον. ut: λεκτῶν, ἐον: πιστῶν, ἐον. Sic & substantiva in εον; ut, ἀσέον.
3. Adjectiva in οῦ. ut: ἀθρόῳ, ἀπλόῳ. Sic etiam ἑκάντῳ.
4. Participia Præteriti passivi. ut: τυμμένῳ, γεγραμμένῳ.
5. Adverbia desinentia in ῶς, ως, ῆ, & οθεν. ut: ἐξανοῦς, ἐξανοῦ, ἐξανῆ, ἐξανοθεν. Præter ἄλλως, & παντως.
main_text.head: OBSERVATIONES. I. Diphthongi finales αυ & οι, nullâ sequente consonante, in accentuum ratione

page.notes: Greek text is badly worn in places; accents and some letters are approximate. Marginal numbers "iii." and "14." are reconstructed from the scan and may be mis-set. Heading level 2 chosen for the Observationes line.
